tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sangs rgyas kyi skyes pa'i rabs kyi bsdus don bzhugs so//

༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ngag gi dbang phyug "$ la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes pa'i rabs 'di la don gsum ste/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa dang*/ gzhung dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la lnga ste/ 'gyur byed kyi mtshan dang*/ brjod bya brjod byed kyi khyad par dang*/ dgos pa'i khyad par dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ mchod par brjod pa'o// gzhung don la gnyis ste/ byang chub sems pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i mdzad pa'o// dang po la bcu/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ thabs mkhas pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ stobs dang*/ ye shes kyi bcu tshan no// thams cad la bcu tshan dang po dang sdom gyi tshigs bcad gnyis so// sbyin pa la bcu ste/ lus kyi sbyin pa dang*/ yan lag sbyin pa dang*/ bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ bdud kyis mi 'phrogs pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ ma chags pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ rten dman kyang sbyin pa dang*/ chos sbyin pa dang*/ ma zhum pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ yongs su gtong ba dang*/ skyabs kyi sbyin pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsum/ dad pa bskyed pa/ rtsom pa la rang bzo spang ba/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan spyir bstan pa'o// rtogs pa brjod pa la gsum te/ rigs dang khyim na gnas pa'i yon tan/ mngon par byung ba'i khyad par dang*/ sbyin pa ji ltar mdzad pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ rigs dang*/ sbyang pa'i yon tan dang*/ dpe bstan pa dang*/ grags pa'i khyad par ro// gnyis pa mngon par byung ba'i khyad par la lnga/ mngon par byung ba'i tshul/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi de'i yon tan/ slob ma'i tshogs 'dus pa/ chos bstan pa/ de yis don byas pa'i khyad par ro// gsum pa sbyin pa ji ltar mdzad tshul la drug /dben par snying rje'i yul gzigs pa/ thugs brtse ba'i tshul/ slob ma la gdam pa/ bdag gi lus gtong par dgongs pa/

btang ba dngos/ de la yid rang zhing mchod pa'i tshul lo// bzhi pa la bzhi/ gzhan du btsal bar mi rigs pa dang*/ lus sbyin par rigs pa dang*/ gzhan don la dgongs pa dang*/ smon lam gyi don dgongs pa'o// drug pa la gsum/ slob mas mthong ba dang*/ rmad du byung bar bstod pa dang*/ mchod pa'i tshul lo// don bsdu ba la gnyis/ dang bar bya ba dang*/ don bsdu ba dngos so// gnyis pa yan lag sbyin pa la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ sbyin pa ji ltar byas pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu bstan cing rjes su gdams pa'o// dang po la gsum/ yon tan spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu skye ba bzung ba'i yon tan/ de'i khyad par brjod pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ gtong ba dang*/ yongs su gtong ba'o// dang po la lnga/ ji ltar sbyin pa'i tshul/ sbyin pa'i zhing 'dus pa/ dga' ba skyes pa/ grags pa rgyas pa'i dpe/ phongs pa tshim pa'i tshul lo// yongs su gtong ba dang*/ gtong ba'i dgos pa dang*/ de'i mthus sa g.yos pa/ brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ sbyin pa byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bdun/ slong ba nye bar gnas pa'i tshul/ rgyal pos dris pa/ spyan bslangs pa/ dga' ba skyes shing don du 'gyur mi 'gyur dris lan gyis brtags pa/ sbyin par zhal gyi bzhes pa/ blon po nas mi sbyin par gsol ba btab pa dang*/ sbyin pa dngos so// drug pa la bzhi/ spyan mi sbyin par gsol bar dngos dang*/ de'i lan/ dris lan gyis nan tan du bstan pa/ dris lan gyis mig sbyin pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o// bdun pa la gnyis/ mig gnyis byin pa dang*/ dga' ba skyes pa'i tshul lo// gsum pa 'bras bu bsten cing rjes su bstan pa'i tshul la gsum/ brgya byin gyis rkyen byas pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa dngos/ rjes su gdams pa'i don no// dang po la drug brgya byin ngo mtshar ba/ mdun du 'ongs pa rgyal pos dris pa dang lan dang dris lan gyis chog shes pa'i yon tan bstan pa dang*/

'gyod pa yod med dris pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ smon lam gyis mig thob pa dang*/ ngo mtshar gyi khyad par brjod pa/ brgya byin gyis legs so byin pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis ste/ dga' ston rgyas pa dang*/ chos bshad pa'o// gsum pa bsam pa dag pa'i sbyin pa la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gsum pa la bzhi ste/ spyi dang khyad par gyi rgyal po'i yon tan dang*/ sngon gyi rgyus rang nyid dge ba la 'bad pa'i tshul dang*/ gzhan la bsod nams kyi mthu bsgrags pas spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ gzhan don la sbyar ba'o// gsum pa la bdun te/ bsgrags pa dngos dang*/ ngo mtshar ba dang*/ btsun mos dris pa dang*/ don bshad pa/ btsun mos mthun 'gyur brjod pa/ rgyal pos dris shing btsun mo la sgrogs su bcug pa'o// gzhan don la sbyor ba la bzhi ste/ sbyin pa bsngags pa dang*/ ser sna'i nyes pa bstan pa/ phan yon rgyas bshad/ de la gus pas bsgrub pa'o// bzhi pa bdud kyis mi 'phrogs pa'i sbyin pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don ci'i phyir bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ grags pa'i khyad par/ gtong ba byed pa'i tshul/ bdud kyi mi 'phrogs pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum/ sbyin pa'i zhing nye bar gnas pa/ de la bdud kyi gegs byas tshul/ des ma 'phrogs pa'o// gnyis pa la bdun/ dmyal ba sprul pa/ chung ma'i sbyin pa la gegs byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' yis bsams pa/ bdud kyi tshig gis zlogs pa/ lan smras pa/ yang bdud kyis smras pa/ lan no// gsum pa la bzhi/ bsam pa ma 'phrogs pa dang*/ yon tan gyi mthu bstan pa/ bsod snyoms phul ba/ bdud mi snang bar gyur pa'o// lnga pa ma chags pa'i sbyin pa la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ spyi'i yon tan dang*/ gtong ba'i khyad par dang*/ bar chod kyis ma 'phrogs pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum ste/

'byor pa med pas ma bzlogs pa dang*/ tshig gis ma bzlogs pa dang*/ brgya byin gyi bsngags pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ brgya byin gyis sbas pa/ lhag par snying rje skyes pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la gsum te/ brgya byin gyi tshig gis bzlogs pa dang*/ de'i lan dang*/ re zhig kyang ma bzlogs pa'o// lan la gsum te/ sbyin pa las bzlog par mi rigs pa'i tshul dang*/ ser sna'i nyes pa/ brgya byin la bzod par gsol ba'o// re shig kyang ma bzlogs pa la gnyis/ bzlog pa dang*/ lan no// de la gsum ste/ gtong ba rang don dang*/ gzhan don yin pa'i tshul/ longs spyod mi rtag pa'i tshul/ lam bzang por bstan pa'o// brgya byin gyis bsngags pa la bzhi/ dam pa'i tshul bstan pa/ bsngags pa'i rgyu/ bsngags pa dngos/ nor byin te bzod par gsol ba'o// drug pa rten dman kyang sbyin pa la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gnas dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan dang*/ gtong ba'i khyad par ro// gnyis pa la lnga/ bdag nyid kyi yon tan/ slob ma'i khyad par spyi'i yon tan/ grags pa gsal ba'i tshul/ chos bstan pa'o// de la bzhi/ dus tshigs kyi dge ba la 'bad par bya ba/ bsod nams spel bar gdams pa/ dpes rgyas par bshad pa/ de bsgrubs pa'i tshul lo// gtong ba'i khyad par la lnga/ bsam pa dang*/ mthu bstan pa/ brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ ri bong gis dbugs phyung ba/ sbyin pa byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi/ sram dang*/ lce spyang dang*/ spre'u dang*/ byang chub sems dpas sbyin pa mdzad pa'o// de la bdun/ lus sbyin pa'i tshul/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ de'i lan/ brgya byin gyis me sprul pa/ lus sbyin pa dngos/ brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ 'jig rten la bstan pa'o// bdun pa chos sbyin pa la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/

don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ khyim na gnas pa'i yon tan/ rab tu byung zhing dben pa mdzad pa'i tshul/ dben par gnas pa'i yon tan gyi tshul lo// dang po la gsum ste/ rigs dang*/ sbyangs pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ khyim gyi nyes pa gzigs pa dang*/ rgyu des rab tu byung ba/ dben pa bsten pa'o// gsum pa la bzhi/ sbyin pa la goms pa'i yon tan/ brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ chog shes pa'i yon tan/ brgya byin gyis legs par smras pas tshim par byas pa'o// de la bdun ste/ brgya byin 'ongs pa/ byang chub sems dpas mkhyen nas mgron byas pa/ des nan tan tu brtags pa/ brgya byin dogs pa skyes te dris pa/ de'i lan/ brgya byin gyis mchog byin pa/ slong ba la snyad btags ste chos bshad pa'o// de la bcu/ 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs bstan pa/ zhe sdang spang bar bstan pa/ dris lan mdor bstan dang rgyas bshad kyis gti mug can spang ba dang*/ brgya byin shin tu 'dun pas mchog byin pa dang*/ brtan pa'i mchog blangs pa/ dris lan gyis de bshad pa/ yang mchog byin pa/ de'i lan/ g.yeng ba spang bar bstan pa'o// de la gsum ste/ dris lan gyis brgya byin mi 'byon par gsol ba/ dris lan gyis de'i rgyu bstan pa/ rang sangs rgyas mchod pa'i tshul lo// brgyad pa ma zhum pa'i sbyin pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ byang chub sems da pa'i yon tan dang*/ gnod pa bzlog pa dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi don mdzad pa dang*/ 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ spyi'i yon tan/ bye brag tu rgyal po'i yon tan/ rgyu des dar ba'i tshul lo// gnod pa bzlog pa la drug gnod sbyin gyis mdangs 'phrog ma nus pa/ de'i rgyu bstan pa/ ngo mtshar skyes pa/ bram zer bsgyur te ba lang rdzi dang dris lan mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad dang*/

rgyal po'i yon tan brjod pa'o// de la gsum ste/ dngos dang ba lang rdzi yis bstan pa/ dris lan gyis rgyas par bshad pa'o// gnod sbyin gyi don mdzad pa la drug /mi bzod pa skyes pa/ rgyal po la zas bslangs pa/ bza' ba'i mchog byin pa/ gnod sbyin gyis kha zas bslangs shing rang gzugs bstan pa/ rgyal po brtse ba'i sems skyes pa dang*/ rang gi lus gtong ba mdzad pa'o// de la lnga ste/ sbyin par khas blangs pa dang*/ des bstan par byas pa dang*/ gsol ba dang lam gyis bar chad kyis ma 'phrogs pa/ byin pa'i tshul dngos so// de la brgyad ste/ khrag sbyin pa/ sha sbyin pa/ gnod sbyin gyi sems dul ba/ bzod par gsol ba/ sbyin pa'i rgyu dris pa/ lan dang*/ gnod sbyin gyis smon lam btab pa/ sdom pa la bkod pa'o// bzhi pa 'bras bu la gsum te ltas kyi khyad par dang*/ brgya byin gyi bsngags pa/ lus sor chud pa'o// dgu pa yongs su gtong ba la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar pa dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yab kyi yon tan dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan dang*/ gtong ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ sbyin pa'i grags pa rgyas pa/ dga' ba thob pa'i tshul/ gtong ba dang*/ yongs su gtong ba mdzad pa'o// gtong ba la lnga ste/ gzhan gyis brtag pa'i phyir bram ze btang pa'i tshul/ bslangs pa'i tshul/ ji ltar byin pa/ rgyu des shi bi pa rnams 'khrugs pa/ de'i rkyen gyis dben par song ba'o// de la dgu ste/ rgyal pos smras pa/ dris lan gyis dben par btang ba'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa' la sbran pa/ dris lan gyi phyug pa'i rgyu dris pa/ 'gro bar dam bcas pa/ dri lan gyis sbyin pa bsngags pa/ ma dris spro ba bskyed pa/ 'phongs pa rnams mya ngan skyes pa/ byon pa dngos so// yongs su gtong ba la bdun ste/ rta byin pa dang*/ dris lan gyis bsod nams kyi khyad par bsten pa dang*/

shing rta byin pa dang*/ dben par rkang gis byon pa'i tshul/ dben gnas kyi yon tan bshad pa/ ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul/ bu dang chung ma ji ltar byin pa'o// de la gnyis/ bu byin pa dang*/ chung ma byin pa'o// dang po la bcu gnyis/ sbyin pa'i zhing nye bar lhags pa/ ci 'dod dris pa/ sras bslangs pa/ sbyin par dam bcas pa/ sang khrid cig par bsgo ba dris lan brjod pa/ byin pa dngos/ gzhon nu gnyis kyis gsol pa/ bram zes khrid pa'i tshul/ gzhon nu gnyis kyis smre sngags brjod pa/ byang chub sems pa'i dgongs pa/ yum gyi mya ngan bsal ba'o// de la lnga ste ltas mthong ba/ byang chub sems dpa' la dris pa/ mya ngan skyes pa'i tshul/ mya ngan bsal ba'i tshul/ btsun mo yid rang ba'o// chung ma byin pa la bdun/ brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ btsun mo blangs pa/ byin pa'i tshul/ ma dri'i tshul/ brgya byin yid rang ba/ ma dri slar phul ba/ slar sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// bcu pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa la gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ chos dang mthun pa'i tshul/ de skye dgu'i skyabs mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la brgyad ste/ gnod pa'i tshul/ thar pa'i thabs dris pa/ blon pos gsol ba/ de thabs kyis bzlog pa/ mchod sbyin bya bar nan tan gyis gsol ba/ byang chub sems dpas bsams pa/ skabs gzhan gyis de khyad du bsad pa/ blon pos bstod pa'o// bdun pa la dgu/ mchog sbyin byed par bstan pa/ blon pos gsol ba/ bka' khrims bsgrags pa/ 'bangs rnams 'dun pa/ ji ltar nyul ba/ rgyu des sbyin gnas su gyur pa'i tshul/ chos kyi mchod sbyin mdzad pa/ blon pos mnyan pa/ de'i yon tan ji ltar rgyas pa'o// blon pos bsngags pa la gsum/ bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa rjes su mthun par brjod pa'o// tshul khrims kyi bcu tshan la bcu ste/ srog gcod pa spongs ba dang*/

ma byin len spong ba/ 'dod log spong ba/ ngag gi las spang ba dang*/ smon lam gyis mthu dang*/ bden tshig gi yon tan dang*/ chang spong ba dang*/ bag med pa'i gnas spong ba dang*/ dge ba chos sdud dang*/ sems can don byed kyi skyes pa'i rabs so// dang po la gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi las/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul/ rgol ba nye bar gnas pa/ de ji ltar bzlog pa'o// de la dgu ste/ rang gi dpung gi khyad par/ g.yul bkye ba/ re shig lha min rgyal ba/ snying rje'i yul mthong ba/ 'tshe ba bzlog pa/ dris lan gyis shing rta bsgyur ba/ rnam par rgyal ba'i tshul/ lha rnams kyis bstod pa/ don gzhan la sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa ma byin len spong ba'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan/ bla ma mnyes pa/ des slob ma rnams brtags pa'o// de la bdun ste/ tshig mdor brjod pa/ gsal bar bskul ba/ slob ma rnams kyis dris pa/ mkhan pos smras pa/ dris lan gyis bskul ba bstan pa/ gzhan dag gis mnyan pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ma g.yos pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ ngo mtshar skyes pa/ mkhan pos dris pa/ lan bstan pa/ mkhan pos bsngags pa'o// lan la bzhi ste/ mi srid pa dang*/ mi mthong pa med pa'i tshul/ mi dge ba rig pa/ ma byin par mi len pa'i tshul lo// gsum pa 'dod log spong ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum te/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyi dang bye brag gis yon tan/ myos byed ma'i tshul/ 'dod pas ma 'phrogs pa bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la bdun te/ gzugs kyi yon tan/ rgyal po la phul ba/ rtog tu bcugs pa/ bram ze rnams myos par byas pa/ de dag gis bsams pa/ mi rigs par gsol ba/

blon po la byin pa'o// 'dod pas ma 'phrogs pa la drug ste/ ku mu ta'i dga' ston/ myos byed mas brtags pa/ rgyal pos mthong ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba la dris pa/ de'i lan/ 'dod pas ma 'phrogs pa dngos so// de la bcu gcig ste/ sems ma 'phrogs pa/ blon pos phul ba/ ma bzhes pa/ blon pos gsol ba/ de'i lan/ dris lan gyis chos kyi lam bstan pa/ dris lan gyis nan tan du smras pa/ dris lan gyis 'gal ba'i lam spang ba/ dris lan gyis don spyad pa/ dris lan gyis 'bangs skyong ba'i tshul/ blon pos bstod pa'o// bzhi pa ngag las spong ba'i yon tan gyi skyes rabs la gsum ste 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ tshong pa'i don ji ltar byed pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ mdor bstan dang*/ bde legs kyi khyad par dang*/ de'i rgyas bshad/ snying rjes don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la drug ste/ byang chub sems dpa' grur zhugs pa/ dga' ba skyes pa/ rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin bshad pa/ 'jigs pa'i rkyen/ rgya mtsho du ma 'das pa/ mthar don grub pa'i tshul lo// lnga pa la bdun te/ byang chub sems dbugs phyung ba/ spu gri'i phreng ba can dang*/ zho 'phreng dang*/ me'i 'phreng ba dang*/ ku sha'i phreng can dang*/ 'dam bu'i phreng can 'das pa dang*/ klong gi khar phyin pa'o// de la lnga ste/ klong mthong ba/ byang chub sems dpa' la dris pa/ de'i lan/ smre sngags 'don pa/ snying rje skyes te dbugs phyung ba'o// drug pa mthar don grub pa'i tshul la bzhi ste/ smon lam brjod pa/ de'i yon tan/ nor bu blangs pa'i tshul/ don grub pa'o// lnga pa smon lam gyi mthus bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ gnas kyi khyad par/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la lnga ste/

ji ltar bskyangs pa/ gnod pa nye bar gnas tshul/ snying rje skyes pa/ smon lam brjod pa/ de'i 'bras bu grub tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ sprin 'dus pa/ char pa bab tshul/ nan tan du smon lam brjod pa/ brgya byin yid rang ba'o// drug pa bden pa'i tshig gis yon tan bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la dgu ste/ skye ba bzung ba'i tshul/ de'i yon tan/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis 'tsho ba'i khyad par bstan pa/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis me'i rang bzhin brjod pa/ rgyu des gzhan dag bros pa'i tshul/ byang chub sems pas smon lam brjod pa/ de'i mthus me zhi ba/ ding sang yang grags pa'i tshul/ rgyu mtshan bstan pa'o// bdun pa chang spong ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yon tan dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ log par spyod pa mthong ba/ snying rje skyes la/ rdzu 'phrul gyi 'dun pa byas pa/ tshig gis bstan pa'o// de la lnga ste/ bum pa nyo'am dris pa/ dris lan gyis nyes pa mdor bstan/ 'tshong ba'i rgyu dris pa/ de'i lan/ gus pas rjes su bsgrub pa'o// lan la bcu gnyis te/ nyon gcig par bskul ba/ lus nyams pa'i nyes pa/ sems nyams pa'i nyes pa/ log par spyod pa'i nyes pa/ khyi dang mtshungs pa'i nyes pa/ mi rigs par spyod pa'i nyes pa/ nor nyams pa'i nyes pa/ blo nyams pa'i nyes pa/ ngag nyams pa'i nyes pa/ mtho ris nyams pa'i nyes pa/ nyes pa thams cad kyi gzhir bstan pa/ ngan 'gro'i rgyur bstan pa'o// gus pa rjes su bsgrubs pa la bzhi/ dam bcas pa/ mchod cing gsol ba/ yang rjes su bstan pa/ rjes su bsgrub pa'i tshul lo// brgyad pa bag med pa spong ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/

don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rigs dang khyim na gnas pa'i yon tan/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ de'i yon tan/ sdig pa'i grogs pos dkri bar ma nus pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi/ gzhan gyis bkur ba/ pha'i mdza' bos smras pa 'dod pa'i gtam byas pa/ de'i lan no// de la gnyis ste/ khyim gyi nyams pa mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// de la dgu ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar bstan pa/ mi dge ba'i gzhir bstan pa/ chos dang 'gal ba/ bde ba med pa'i tshul/ nga rgyal gyi gzhir bstan pa/ khyim spang bar gdams pa/ dben pa'i yon tan/ don bsdu ba/ mdza' bo de rjes su yid rang ba'o// dgu pa dka' thub can gyi skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan mngon par byung ba'i tshul/ dben par gzhan don mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ rab tu byung ba'i rkyen/ nu bo rnams la gdams pa/ de rnams kyis gsol pa/ ji ltar rab tu byung ba'i tshul dngos so// dben par gzhan don mdzad pa la brgyad/ dben gnas dang*/ chos ston pa'i tshul/ dka' thub kyi khyad par/ de la brgya byin gyis brtags pa'i phyir pad mo sbas pa/ de ma 'khrugs pa'i tshul/ de gzhan rnams kyi rtogs pa/ de rnams kyis mna' bor ba/ brgya byin la chos bstan pa'o// mna' bor ba la gnyis/ mi rnams kyi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la mna' bor ba dang*/ gzhan gyi 'bras bu la mna' bor ba'o// dang po la bcu ste/ khyim gyi 'byor pa dang*/ bud med kyi 'byor pa dang*/ zhing gi 'byor pa dang*/ rgyal po'i 'byor pa dang*/ 'dun na 'don gyi 'byor pa dang*/ bram ze'i 'byor pa dang*/ blon po'i 'byor pa dang*/ grong dpon gyi 'byor pa dang*/ btsun mo'i 'byor pa dang*/ zas kyi 'byor pa'o// 'bras bu la mna' bor ba la bzhi/ yi dwags dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ rang dbang med pa'i mna' bor ba dang*/

byang chub sems dpas mna' bor ba'o// brgya byin la chos ston pa la lnga/ brgya byin gyis dris pa/ de'i lan/ brgya byin gyi nyes pa khas blangs pa/ byang chub sems pas spyod ba byas pa/ bzod par gsol ba'o// bcu pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims bstan pa'i skyes rabs la don gsum ste 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ mngon par byung ba'i rkyen/ rab tu byung ba dngos so// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ mas mya ngan byas pa/ de bzhin du bu mo dang*/ mdza' bshes kyis mya ngan byas pa/ byang chub sems dpas thos pa'i tshul lo// rab tu byung ba dngos la bzhi byang chub sems dpas dgongs pa/ dris lan gyis rgyal po la gsol pa/ dris lan gyis rab tu byung bar gnang ba'i tshul/ mdza' bo'i bar chad kyis ma 'phrogs pa'o// de la gnyis/ rab tu mi 'byung bar gsol ba dang*/ de la ma 'phrogs pa dngos so// de la brgyad de/ dam pa'i spyod pa bstan pa/ sdug bsngal mi rigs par dgongs pa/ dben pa bsten par rigs pa/ rjes su bslab par rigs pa/ yon tan bsgrub pa'i grogs bya bar rigs pa/ de'i rgyas bshad/ bdag nyid bstan par byas pa/ dben par song ba dngos so// bzod pa'i bcu tshan la bcu ste khro ba'i nyes pa bstan pa dang*/ rten dman kyang bzod pa las mi ldog pa dang*/ lta ba ngan pa spang ba dang*/ gnod byed la snying brtse ba dang*/ gnod pa bzod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang du len pa dang*/ gzhan gyi don byed pa dang*/ gnod pa la ci mi snyam pa dang*/ chos la nges par sems pa dang*/ gzhan don la sbyor ba'i bzod pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ dben par byon pa'i tshul/ bzod pa'i don bstan pa'o// de la gsum/

gnod byed nye bar gnas pa dang*/ des dka' thub ldan mi ldan brtags pa/ gnod pa byas pa la bzod pa'o// de la drug ste/ rgyal pos bsgo ba dang*/ gnod pa byed pa dngos dang*/ byang chub sems dpas bzod pa'i tshul dang*/ dris lan gyis bzod pa byas tshul bstan pa/ dris lan gyis khro ba'i sems spang ba/ de'i rgyas bshad do// de la bzhi/ khro ba gdon dang 'dra ba dang*/ me dang 'dra ba dang*/ spangs pa'i yon tan/ shin tu rgyas bshad do// de la drug ste/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyur bshad pa/ dpal nyams ba/ rmongs par gyur pa/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba/ spang bar bstan pa/ de la rgyal po 'dun pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa rten dman kyang mi ldog pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ de'i grags pa rgyas pa/ gzhan gyi don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la gnyis/ ba ra na ser 'gro ba'i rkyen/ der phyin nas don byas pa dngos so// dang po la drug dris lan gyis thabs bsam pa/ mtsho byas pa/ de'i khyad par rgyas bshad/ mi 'jigs pa sgrogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi mthong ba/ de'i tshul mthong ba'o// gnyis pa la dgu te/ gzhan bzang dang dris lan byas ba/ gzhan gyi don du phyin pa/ mi rnams kyi mthong ba/ bzung ba'i tshul/ ngang pa gzhan byer ba/ gzhan bzang dang dris lan byas pa/ rngon pas mthong ba/ rngon pa dang dris lan byas pa dang*/ rgyal po'i don byas pa'o// brgyad pa la bzhi/ dris lan mdor bstan dang*/ rgyu mtshan dris lan dang*/ gtong bar gsol ba'i dris lan dang*/ btang ba dngos/ dgu pa la bcu gcig rngon pa'i don byas pa// rgyal po'i drung du khyer ba/ ji ltar bzung ba'i dris lan/ bkur sti byas pa/ ngang pas rgyal po la bsnyun dris pa/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de'i lan/ rngon pa mgu bar byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' la gus pa bskyed pa/

rgyal po dang gzhan bzang dris lan/ byang chub sems dpas rjes su bstan pa'o// de la bzhi/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ shin tu rgyas bshad kyis gdams pa dngos dang*/ rang gi gnas su song ba'i tshul lo// gsum pa lta ba log pa spang ba'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ rgyal po'i don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la brgyad/ chos bstan pa/ sdig pa'i grogs pos dbyen byas pa/ rgyal pos yid ma ches ba/ rgyu des byang chub sems dpa' 'gro bar byas pa/ dris lan mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad kyis 'gro ba'i rgyu bstan pa/ byon nas dben par mngon shes thob pa/ yang byon ste rgyal po'i don mdzad pa'o// de la bdun/ mngon shes kyis bltas pa/ lta ba ngan pa tha dad snang ba gzigs pa/ rgyu des byon pa'i tshul/ rgyal po dang dris lan cung zad byas pa/ blon pos gsung pa/ byang chub sems pas rigs pas tshar bcad pa/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la bkod pa'o// drug pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la lnga ste/ rgyu med smra ba bkag pa/ dbang phyug rgyur smra ba dang*/ las rgyur smra ba dang*/ chad par smra ba dang*/ rgyal rigs kyi gzhung lugs smra ba dgag pa'o// dang po la drug /las yod pas rgyu med du ma grub pa'i tshul/ rgyu med kyi dpe ma grub pa/ gtan tshigs med na mi 'grub pa'i tshul/ de'i rgyas bshad/ rgyu bsgrub bzhin du khas mi len par mi rigs par bstan pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga/ dbang phyug dge sdig byed mkhan du mi 'thad pa dang*/ mchod sbyin don med pa dang*/ gus pa bya bar mi rigs pa dang*/ dbang phyug nyid rgyu med du mi rigs pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// las rgyur smra ba dgag pa la bzhi ste/ sdig pa yod med du mi rung ba'i tshul/ nam yang mi grol ba'i skyon/ rgyu mi 'grub pa'i tshul/ don bsdu ba'o// bzhi pa chad smra dgag pa la bzhi/

chad pa yin na nyes pa med tshul/ rdzun du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa/ des ma grub pa/ don bsdu ba'o// lnga pa rgyal rigs pa dgag pa la gsum gzhung ltar na nyes pa med par rigs pa/ gzhan du 'gyur ba'i nyes pa/ don bsdu ba'o// bdun pa yang dag pa'i lta ba la bkod pa la drug /rdzu 'phrul btang ba/ lta ngan spang bar gdams pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po spang bar gdams pa/ blang dor brtag pa/ chos la bkod pa/ rgyal srid bskyang bar gdams pa'o// de la drug /bya ba byed pa bskyang ba/ dpa' bo bskyang ba/ chos ldan bskyang ba/ dpya mi bslu ba/ don bsdu ba/ rang gi gnas su song ba'o// snying rjes slar bskyal ba/ rnam smin myong ba'i tshul/ bzhi pa gnod byed la snying brtse ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum te 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bdun te/ gnas kyi khyad par/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ snying rje'i zhing nye bar gnas pa/ byang chub sems pas don byas pa'i tshul/ mi des log par spyad pa snying rjes slar bskyal ba/ rnam smin myong ba'i tshul lo// gsum ba la gnyis/ mi zhig gcong rong du lhung ba'i tshul dang*/ sme sngags bton pa'o// bzhi pa la lnga ste byang chub sems dpas gzigs pa/ dris lan byas pa/ dbugs phyung ba nyams tshad pa/ mi de phyung ba'o// lnga pa la gsum/ ngal bas gnyid log pa dang*/ mi des ngan par spyad pa/ byang chub sems dpas gnyid sad de bltas pa'o// drug pa la gnyis/ spyo ba byas pa dang*/ grong 'dab tu bskyal ba'o// bdun pa la gnyis/ rnam smin myong ba dang*/ dris lan gyis de'i rgyu bstan pa'o// lnga pa gnod byed la bzod pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis gnas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gzhan don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la dgu/ rgyal pos ri dwags la phyin pa/

sha ra bha bdas pa/ rgyu des g.yang sar lhung ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa/ mthong nas lhag par brtse ba skyes pa/ rgyu des dris lan smras pa/ g.yang sa nas phyung ba'i tshul/ rgyal pos bstod pa/ chos bstan pa'o// de la bzhi/ snying rje bsgom par bstan pa dang*/ sdig pa spang ba dang*/ bsod nams bsgrub pa dang*/ rgyal pos bstod pa'o// drug pa sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la don gnyis te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa'o// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ gnas dang lus kyi yon tan/ gzhan la phan pa'i tshul/ snying rje'i yul gnas pa/ de'i don byas pa dang*/ rgyal po'i don byas pa'o// bzhi pa la gsum/ chu las bton pa/ mi des smras pa/ de'i lan no// lnga pa la bcu gnyis/ btsun mos rmi lam mthong ba/ rgyu des dris pa/ rgyal po la bshad pa/ btsal ba'i tshul/ mi des bstan pa'i nyes pa/ rgyal pos mthong tshul byang chub sems dpas tshig smras pa/ rgyal po dang dris lan mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad/ rgyu des rgyal po mi de la khros pa/ byang chub sems da pas bskyabs pa/ rgyal po'i don byas pa dngos so// de la gsum/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes pa/ pho brang du bos te chos zhus pa dang*/ bshad pa'o// de la bzhi/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ shin tu rgyas bshad dang*/ rgyal pos bsgrubs pa'o// bdun pa bzod pas gzhan gyi don byed pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gnas dang byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi khyad par/ longs spyod kyi khyad par/ spre'u rnams kyi don byas pa'i tshul/ de la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpas mkhyen cing bsgom/ gnod pa'i rkyen/ byang chub sems dpas don mdzad tshul lo// gnyis pa la bzhi/ shing tog rnyed pa/ rgyal po 'dod sems skyes pa/ shing thog btsal ba'i tshul/ gnod pa byas pa'o// gsum pa la bdun te/

byang chub sems pas snying rje skyes pa'i tshul/ spre'u rnams 'jigs pa las bton pa/ rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes pa/ dris lan gyis 'bad pa'i don/ dris lan gyi yang dag pa'i gzhung lugs bshad pa/ dris lan gyi gzhan don bya bar bstan pa rgyal po la gdams pa'o// brgyad pa gnod pa byed pa la ci mi snyam pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yon tan gyi khyad par dang*/ de gzhan la phan pa byed pa'i tshul dang*/ gnod pa byed pa la bzod pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ mngon par byung ba/ bzod pa'i yon tan grags pa/ gnas kyi yon tan no// gnyis pa la gnyis/ spyi la phan pa dang*/ btsun mo'i don byas pa'o// de la bzhi/ skyes mos tshal du phyin pa'i tshul/ dka' thub kyi tshal du phyin pa/ byang chub sems dpas mthong ba/ de dag la chos bstan pa'o// de la drug ste/ bag yod par bya ba dang*/ dge ba la 'bad pa dang*/ bsod nams rgyan du bstan pa dang*/ sdig pa spang ba dang*/ bzod pa bstan pa/ de'i rgyas bshad do// gsum pa gnod byed la bzod pa'i tshul la bcu gcig ste/ yul nye bar gnas pa/ 'khor dang btsun mos bzlog pa/ ma bzlogs pas mya ngan skyes pa/ rgyal pos smras pa/ de'i lan/ dris lan gyis bzod pa bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rgyal pos gnod pa byas tshul/ byang chub sems pas bzod pa'i tshul/ rgyal pos las kyi 'bras bu myong ba/ blon pos gsol ba/ lan bstan pa'o// dgu pa chos la nge par sems pa'i bzod pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar pa/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bdag nyid kyi yon tan dang*/ rgyal po'i don mdzad tshul lo// de la gsum ste/ yul gyi khyad par/ sdug bsngal gyis 'dun par byas pa/ rjes su bstan pa'o// de la lnga ste/ rang nyid la smras pa/ de thob pa'i rgyu brjod pa/ skye ba gzhan yod par bstan pa dang*/

mi rigs pa tshar bcad pa dang*/ dul nas chos bstan pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la bdun/ 'jig rten mngon sum du bstan pa/ mngon shes kyis mthong ba'i tshul/ mngon sum gyi rigs pas bstan pa/ 'bras bu mthong bas rgyu nges pa'i tshul/ de'i 'thad pa bshad pa/ gtan tshigs nges par bya ba/ ma nges pa spang ba'o// bzhi pa mi rigs pa tshar bcad pa la gsum ste/ nor gtong ba'i tshul/ lta ngan la sbyin par mi rigs pa/ dmyal ba'i nyes pa brjod pa'o// de la bcu ste/ tsha ba dang*/ thig nag dang*/ yang sos dang*/ bsdus 'joms dang*/ ngu 'bod dang*/ ngu 'bod chen po dang*/ tsha ba chen po dang*/ mnar med dang*/ grang dmyal dang*/ nyi tshe pa'i nyes pa brjod pa'o// lnga pa dul nas chos bstan pa la bzhi/ dul ba'i tshul/ dge ba'i lam la 'bad par bstan pa/ de dpes bshad pa/ rgyal pos bsgrubs pa'i tshul lo// bcu pa gzhan don la sbyor ba'i bzod pa'i tshul bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis ste/ gnas dang byang chub sems dpa' yon tan/ des sdug bsngal ba'i skye bo'i don byas pa'o// de la lnga ste/ yul gyi khyad par/ dbugs phyung pa/ 'ong pa'i rgyu dris pa'i lan/ snying rje skyes pa/ don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ bsam pa dang*/ mi rnams kyis dris pa dang*/ rjes su bstan pa dang*/ lus btang ba'o// de la drug ste/ lus btang ba dngos dang*/ ltas kyi khyad par/ mi rnams kyis brtags pa/ mya ngan byas pa/ don la brtags pa/ rjes su bsgrubs pa'i tshul lo// bzhi pa brtson 'grus kyi tshan la bcu ste/ nyes spyod las bzlog pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ tshul khrims la brtson pa dang*/ bzod pa bsgrub pa la brtson pa dang*/ nyes spyod las bzlog pa dang*/ bstan pa la gus pa dang*/ gzhan don la brtson pa dang*/ sbyin pa la brtson pa dang*/ go cha'i brtson 'grus dang*/

'jug pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis mi 'phrogs pa'o// dang po la gsum 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis ste/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan/ su ta sa'i don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bdun ste/ yon tan la gus pa/ skyed mos tshal du byon pa/ su ta sa dang phrad tshul/ dris lan byas pa/ gnas su khyer pa/ bram ze'i don byas pa dang*/ su ta sa'i don byas pa dang dngos so// drug pa la drug ste/ bram ze dran pa/ rgyu des dris lan smras pa/ dris lan gyis 'ong ba'i rgyu smras pa/ su ta sas btang ba/ bram ze mgu bar byas pa/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad don bsdus kyis thos pa'i yon tan no// bdun pa la bcu ste/ yab dang dris lan byas pa/ phyin pa/ dris lan byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' spyos pa/ yang dris lan brjod pa/ gzhung lugs kyi dris lan/ 'ong ba'i rgyu dris lan/ dris lan gyis 'chi ba la mi 'jigs pa'i rgyu bshad pa/ su ta sa dad pa skyes pa/ chos bstan pa'o// de la drug ste/ chos nyan tshul bstan pa/ chos bshad pa/ su ta sas dam bcas pa'i tshul/ dam bca' phog pa/ dris lan gyis dam bca' bstan par byas pa/ rgyal srid la bkod pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa tshul khrims la brtson pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ mngon par byung ba'i tshul lo// dang po la bzhi ste yon tan mdor bstan/ 'byor pa'i tshul/ ji ltar bskyed pa/ 'gro ba'i yid dang mthun pa'o// mngon par byung ba'i tshul la lnga ste mngon par 'byung ba'i rkyen/ thugs la dgongs pa/ yab la gsol pa/ dris lan gyis mngon par byung ba'i mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la gnyis te/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bshad pa/ dpes bstan pa'o// de la bcu bzhi te dmag dpung dang*/ glang chen/ dpa' bo// seng ge /rgyal po/

sbrul chen/ khyung*/ stag /'byung po/ sgyu ma mkhan/ sngags dang*/ rigs bsngags 'chang*/ lha dang lha ma yin gyis bzlog par mi nus pa dang*/ rgyu des dben par 'gro ba'i tshul lo// de la gnyis ste/ rgyal pos smras pa dang*/ de'i lan byung ba dngos so// gsum pa bzod pa bsgrub pa'i brtson 'grus la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum te/ byang chub sems dpa' yon tan/ gzhan don la sbyar ba/ gnod pa bzod pa'i tshul lo// de la drug te/ gnod pa byed tshul/ de la bzod pa/ gnod sbyin gyis smras pa/ de'i lan/ dris lan gyis bzod pa'i rgyu/ gnod sbyin gyis bstod pa'o// bzhi pa nyes spyod bzlog pa'i bzod pa la gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la dgu ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ snying rje'i yul mthong ba/ don byas pa'i tshul/ re shig zas ma rnyed pa/ seng ges smras la/ de la bzod pa'i tshul/ lhas dri ba byas pa/ de'i lan/ lhas bstod pa'o// lnga pa bstan pa la gus pa'i brtson 'grus la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la dgu rgyal po'i yon tan/ gnas kyi khyad par byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ gnod par bsams pa/ gnod pa byas pa'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa/ ched du brjod pa/ ltas kyi khyad par/ don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi/ rngon pa dang rgyal po'i dris lan/ seng ges smras pa'i don bsams pa/ mchod pa byas pa/ de'i 'bras bu'o// drug pa gzhan don la brtson pa'i tshul khrims kyi skyes pa'i rabs la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des nyams thag pa sgrol ba'i tshul lo// de la bdun/ rgya mtshor phyin pa/ de'i tshul bshad pa/ gnod pa ji ltar byung ba/ nyams thag pas gsol ba'i tshul/

dbugs phyung ba/ rjes su bstan pa/ ji ltar bsgral ba'o// drug pa rjes su bstan pa la lnga ste/ nor sdug bsngal gyi rtsa bar bstan pa/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal/ don bsdu ba'o// bdun pa la bzhi/ bdag srog dang phral ba/ rgyu des tshong pa thon pa/ ngo mtshar skyes pa/ phyis byung ba bstan pa'o// bdun pa sbyin pa la brtson pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis ste byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la bdun/ 'bangs bskyangs pa'i tshul dang*/ mu ge las skyob pa'i thabs bsams pa/ bsgrubs pa'i tshul/ bag yod par gdams pa/ de'i yon tan/ mthar mu ge byung ba/ rang sangs rgyas mchod pa la 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ rang sangs rgyas byon pa/ bsod snyoms phul zhing smon lam btab pa/ 'dun par byas pa/ 'bras bu thob tshul lo// brgyad pa go cha'i brtson grus bstan pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la don gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ rgyal po'i spyod tshul/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gnod pa dang du blang ba'i tshul lo// de la bcu gcig /rgyal pos bsgo ba/ ji ltar btsal ba'i tshul/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba/ byang chub sems dpas don mdzad pa/ rngon pas bsam pa/ dris lan byas pa/ lpags pa btang ba'i tshul lo// lha rnams kyis mchod pa/ lus btang ba'i tshul/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ phyis byung ba'i tshul lo// dgu pa 'jug pa'i brtson grus bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des snyigs ma'i sems can gyi don mdzad tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ sdig pa las bzlog pa/ rgyal por gyur pa/

tshul khrims la bkod pa/ gtong ba mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum ste/ gtong ba mdzad pa/ de'i don bshad pa/ gtong ba chen po mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la brgyad ste/ slong ba nye bar gnas pa dang*/ de'i lan dang*/ gzhan gyi gegs byas pa/ des ma 'phrog par mig byin pa dang*/ lpags pa byin pa dang*/ rgyu des ched du brjod pa/ bzod pa'i tshul/ ltas kyi khyad par ro// bcu pa bsdu bsngal gyis mi 'phrog pa'i skyes rabs la don gsum/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ thugs la dgongs pa/ brtson pa'i khyad par bstan pa'o// de la drug spyod pa dang*/ bstod pa brjod pa/ de'i tshul bshad pa/ gzhan gyis bstod pa/ lung bstan pa'i tshul/ de ltar spyod pa'i rgyu bshad pa'o// lnga pa bsam gtan gyi bcu tshan la bcu ste bsam gtan la sbyor ba dang*/ dben pa bsgrub pa dang*/ rten dman pas kyang grub pa dang*/ 'dod pas mi 'phrogs pa dang*/ rkyen gyi mi rdzi ba dang*/ gzhan don la spyod pa dang*/ shes rab kyis zin pa dang*/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa dang*/ 'khor ba spang ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des bsam gtan btsal pa'i tshul lo// de la brgyad/ sgra thos pa/ dris lan byas pa/ ji ltar phyin pa'i tshul/ de'i yon tan gyi khyad par/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ zhu ba byas pa/ de'i lan/ zhus lan gyis bsam gtan gyi don bshad pa'o// gnyis pa dben pa bsgrub pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la brgyad te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des skyes dgu bskyangs pa'i tshul/ mngon par 'byung ba'i rkyen/ thugs la dgongs pa/

mngon par 'byung ba'i tshul/ dben gnas kyi khyad par/ des yon tan thob pa/ gzhan gyi don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum ste/ snying rje'i zhing nye bar gnas pa/ don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la gus pa bskyed pa'o// gsum pa rten dman kyang grub pa'i skyes rabs la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gnas kyi khyad par/ bdag po'i tshul/ des bsam gtan la gus pa bskyed pa'i tshul lo// de la lnga/ dris lan bstan pa/ dris lan gyis skye ba'i rgyu/ bram ze 'gro bar chas pa/ ri bong gis smras pa dang lan/ lus btang ba'i tshul lo// de la lnga ste/ bsam pa dang*/ dris lan byas pa/ btang ba dngos/ bstod cing rjes su bsgrub pa/ don bshad pa'o// bzhi pa 'dod pas mi 'phrogs pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ longs spyod kyi khyad par/ bsam gtan gyi stobs bskyed pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum/ bsam pa dang*/ mngon shes kyis gzigs tshul/ chos bstan pa'o// de la gsum/ spang bya dang*/ gnyen po bsten tshul/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ 'dod pa'i gnyen po dang*/ zhe sdang gi gnyen po dang*/ gti mug gnyen po'o// don bsdu ba la gnyis/ gzhan don gyi tshul dang*/ rang don grub pa'o// lnga pa rkyen gyis mi rdzi ba la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ rgyal po'i don mdzad pa/ gnod pas ma 'phrogs pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ rgyal po 'ongs pa dang chos bstan pa'o// bzhi pa la lnga ste/ gnod pa byed pa'i rgyu/ phrag dog skyes pa/ rgyal po ma 'phrogs pa/ nu bo la smras pa/ gnod pas ma 'phrogs pa dngos so// lnga pa la gsum ste/

sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu dang*/ yon tan gyi 'bras bu dang*/ phyis byung ba'o// drug pa gzhan don la spyod pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ mdor bstan/ zhing gi khyad par/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ sangs rgyas byon tshul/ chos thos shing bsgrubs pa'o// de la bzhi/ thos tshul/ rab tu byung ba/ de'i yon tan don gzhan la sbyar ba'o// de la gsum/ bsgom par gdams pa/ phyi dus lung bstan/ gdams pa'o// de la bdun/ grogs ngan spang ba/ tshul khrims bsrung ba/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa/ mchod pa/ sku gzugs bya ba/ dben pa bsten par gdams pa dang*/ mjug bsdud do// bdun pa shes rab kyis zin pa bstan pa la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ dus ston byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa'o// de la dgu/ dgongs pa/ mdzad pa/ chos bstan pa/ rgyal pos mthong ba/ rgyu des dris lan rgyal pos bstod pa/ lan bstan pa/ smon lam mdzad pa/ yon tan gyi 'bras bu bstan pa'o// brgyad pa lhag bsam dag pa bstan pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gzhan don mdzad pa/ gnod pas ma 'phrogs pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba'o// gsum pa la drug te/ log pa'i skye bo'i tshul/ rgyal pos bsrungs ba/ gnod byed nye bar gnas pa/ smon lam mdzad pa/ de'i yon tan bstan pa/ don gzhan la bstan pa'o// de la gsum/ spyad pa spyod pa gang yin pa/ ma 'ongs pa bstan pa dang*/ gdams pa'o// dgu pa 'khor ba spang ba bstan pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis rgyal po byung ba'i tshul/

byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa'o// de la brgyad byang chub sems dpa' chags tshul/ btsas pa'i tshul/ ji ltar bskyed pa/ skye ba dran cing bsam pa/ thabs byas pa/ rgyu des blon po dang dris lan/ gzhon nus ji ltar smras pa dang*/ don bsgrub pa'o// bdun pa la bcu/ rgyal pos bsgo zhing khrid pa/ gzhon nus smras pa/ shi ba dris pa/ 'bras bu'i phung po dris pa/ rgyas pos bsgo ba/ gzhon nus dris pa/ de'i lan/ dris lan gyis rgyal po la gsol ba/ dga' ston gyi khyad par/ gzhon nu dang rgyal po drin lan no// de la bzhi/ dris lan gyis rab tu byung bar gsol ba/ dris lan gyi rgyu bstan pa/ dris lan gyis dben par 'gro tshul/ dris lan gyi tshig snga ma'i don bshad pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ rab tu byung bar gnang ba'o// brgyad pa don bsgrub pa la gsum/ rab tu byung ba'i tshul/ byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa/ yon tan thob pa'i tshul lo// bcu pa 'jig rten las 'das pa bstan pa la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdus pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa' yon tan/ bsam gtan gyi mthu bskyed pa'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad don bsdud do// gnyis pa la lnga// thugs la dgongs pa dben par bsgrub par dgongs nas chos bstan pa dben gnas kyi khyad par/ yon tan thob nas don byad pa'i tshul/ don brjod pa'o// drug pa shes rab kyi bcu tshan la bcu ste/ shes rab dang ldan pas chos tshol ba dang*/ thos pas ngoms pa med pa dang*/ chos smra ba la gus pa dang*/ chos bstan pa'i che ba dang*/ blo gros kyi che ba dang*/ bsgom pa'i shes rab dang*/ dpyod pa'i shes rab dang*/ 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i shes rab dang*/ rten dman kyang mdzes pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab bo// dang po la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi te/

byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ de chos la gus pa'i tshul/ brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ mgu bar byas pa'o// gsum pa la dgu ste/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ dris lan byas pa/ rgyal po dga' ba skyes pa/ gzhan kyang rjes su mthun pa brgya byin ngo mtshar skyes nas smras ba/ chos la gus pa'i tshul/ brgya byin gyis bstod cing mchog byin pa/ de'i lan/ dris lan gyis 'dod pa'i nyes pa bstan pa'o// gnyis pa thos pas ngoms pa med pa'i skyes pa'i rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ spyi dang bye brag gis byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ yon tan gyi khyad par gzhan dang*/ des chos la gus pa bskyed pa'i tshul lo// de la dgu/ mi zhig dang phrad cing dris lan byas pa/ mi rigs pa bsams pa/ dris lan gyis ma chags par bstan pa/ chos bshad pa/ lhag bsam gyi mthu bstan pa/ mi de 'dun par gyur pa/ dris lan byas pa/ slar rjes su bzung bar gsol ba/ 'bras bu grub pa'i tshul lo// gsum pa chos smra ba la gus pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bdun/ rgyal po'i yon tan/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ chos ston pa nye bar gnas pa/ de na ba'i tshul/ gsol pa/ de'i rgyu rgyal po dang dris lan/ dris lan gyi 'bras bu bshad pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ gnod par ma gyur pa'i tshul/ gsos pa'i yon tan gzhan don du gyur tshul/ de dag gang yin pa bstan pa'o// bzhi pa chos bstan pa'i che ba la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan/ des don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la gnyis/ nad las thar par mdzad pa dang*/ nya'i don byas pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ na ba la snying rje skyes pa/ gso ba'i thabs dris pa/ lan dang*/ nad gsos pa'o// gnyis pa nya'i don byas pa la bdun/

snying rje'i yul mthong ba/ thabs bsam pa/ shing gi lha mo bzhi dang dris lan/ snying rje skyes pa/ chu byin pa/ zas byin pa/ de'i mthu bstan pa'o// de la gsum/ lhar skyes shing mchod pa/ de'i rgyu bsgrags pa/ ji ltar gyur pa bstan pa'o// lnga pa blo gros kyi che ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ rgyal po'i yon tan/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ de rgyal por gyur pa'i tshul/ shes rab kyis sems can bskyangs pa'o// gsum pa la gsum rgyal pos bsam pa/ brtags pa dang*/ rgyal por gyur pa'o// bzhi pa la bzhi/ 'jig rten gyi nyes spyod grub pa'i tshul/ chos dang mthun par zhi bar mdzad pa/ bka' bzhin du bsgrubs pa/ mchod sbyin mdzad pa'o// de la gsum/ mu ge byung ba dang*/ sbyin pa mdzad pa/ skye bo la rjes su bstan pa'o// drug pa bsgom pa'i shes rab la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ byang chub sems dpal 'dun na 'don du bskos pa/ des 'di dang phyi ma'i don bstan pa'i tshul lo// de la bcu gcig /rgyal rigs la rjes su bstan pa/ dus la bab pa/ bde ba'i thabs bsams pa/ so so'i dpal la bkod pa/ rgyal rigs kyis bstod pa/ 'jig rten gyis bsngags pa/ rgyu des tshangs pa bsgrub pa/ dris lan byas pa/ chos dris pa/ de'i lan/ rgyu des rab tu byung ba'o// de la bzhi/ rgyal po dang dris lan/ rgyal rigs drug dang dris lan/ mngon par byung ba/ don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// bdun pa rnam dpyod kyi skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ sngon byung ba dang*/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan/ rgyal pos brtags pa/ rang gi blo gros bstan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la zhus lan no// bzhi pa la gnyis/

dge sbyong dang*/ bram ze rnams la dris pa dang lan no// de la bcu/ dbul ba'i gnod pa/ dbang chung ba/ blun pa/ mdza' bshes med pa/ bzo mi shes pa/ rgyal srid nyams pa/ chung ma mi srun pa/ ma byin par len pa/ drin du mi bzo ba bstan pa dang*/ gzhon nus bshad pa'o// lnga pa la gsum te/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du phyin pa/ zhus pa/ lan gsungs pa'o// de la bzhi/ skye rgas kyi gnod pa dang sgyu ma ltar rtogs par byas pa dang*/ de'i yon tan no// brgyad pa 'jig rten dang mthun pa'i shes rab bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum te/ spyi dang bye brag gis yon tan/ gnod byed gnas pa'i tshul/ de la bzod pa bstan pa'o// de la gnyis/ dris pa dang*/ lan no// de la bco lnga/ drin bzo bstan pa/ bzod par bya ba/ grags pa 'jig pa'i tshul/ brnyas pa bzod pa/ bde ba'i bstan pa/ phan par spyod pa/ khro ba'i skyon/ blun po'i mtshan nyid/ mkhas pa'i tshul dus su spyod pa/ bzod pa bya ba'i tshul/ dpes bstan pa/ thams cad bzod pa/ gzhan du 'gro bar bstan pa/ spang bya bstan pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ nyes pa'i rgyu spang ba dang*/ che ba'i phyir chung ngu btang ba/ chos bsgrub par bstan pa/ nyer lngas bstod pa'o// dgu pa rten dman pa la yang shes rab mdzes par bstan pa la yang gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gnod pa las skyabs pa'o// de la lnga ste/ gzhan la gnod byed gnas pa dang*/ sdug bsngal skyes pa/ byang chub sems dpas dbug phyung ba/ byang chub sems dpas thabs gyis smras pa/ ji ltar bde bar gyur pa'i tshul lo// bcu pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab bstan pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan/

des gzhan gyi don byas pa'i tshul lo// de la lnga ste/ shes rab dman pa'i skyon dang*/ ji ltar log lta skyes pa/ rgyu des dmyal bar song ba/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje skyes pa/ de dag gi don mdzad pa'o// de la bzhi/ dmyal ba'i me zhi bar byas pa/ sems can rnams dad pa/ chos bstan pa/ de dag gi don gyur pa'o// bdun pa thabs mkhas pa bstan pa'i bcu tshan la bcu ste/ srog gcod pa ltar ston pa dang*/ longs spyod 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang*/ 'dod pas mi gos pa dang*/ thabs gzhan gyis sems can 'dul ba dang*/ thabs kyis ston pa dang*/ 'gro ba'i yid bzhin 'jug pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i nyes pa ston pa dang*/ 'byor pas sems can 'khrid pa dang*/ zhi bas 'dul ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa thob pa'o// dang po la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des snying rje chen po'i spyod pa bstan pa'o// de la brgyad/ tshong pa dang rgya mtshor phyin pa/ gnod byed nye bar gnas pa/ lhas smras pa/ ji ltar dgongs pa/ mi de bsgral ba/ gzhan dag gis dris pa/ de la bstod pa/ phan yon no// gnyis pa longs spyod 'dzin pa'i thabs mkhas pa bstan pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ byang chub sems dpas mdor bstan zhing khams kyi khyad par/ rgyal pos de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i don mdzad pa'o// gsum pa la bzhi te/ mchod pa dngos/ zhus lan gyis chos bstan pa dang*/ de'i phan yon/ bstod pa'o// bzhi pa la bdun/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ba/ rab tu byung ba bsngags pa/ sangs rgyas la zhus pa/ bu rnams la smras pa de'i lan/ nan tan du smras pa/ snying rje cher sems kyi spyod pa'o// de la drug snying rje'i bsgrub pa dang*/ dam bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kyis bsngags pa rgyal po rab tu byung ba/

snying rje cher sems kyis mdzad pa/ gang yin bstan pa'o// gsum pa 'dod pas ma gos pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ dben par gnas pa'i tshul/ des snying rje'i spyod pa bstan pa'o// de la drug ste/ 'dod pa can nye bar gnas pa/ snying rje skyes pa/ 'dod pa'i nyes pa dgongs pa/ gzhan don mdzad pa/ slar mngon par byung ba/ don bshad pa'o// bzhi pa thabs gzhan gyis sems can 'dul ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des sems can nyes pa las bzlog pa'i tshul lo// de la lnga ste/ log par spyod pa mthong ba/ thabs bsams pa/ sprul pa byas pa/ mi rnams dang dris lan/ don byas pa dngos so// lnga pa thabs kyis don ston pa'i skyes rabs la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ gnas kyi khyad par/ brtson mi brtson gyi khyad par dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u don mdzad pa'o// de la drug ste/ bsams pa dang*/ dben pa mdzad pa/ ri dwags la smras pa/ ri dwags kyis rtul zhugs can la smras pa/ bram ze rnams kyis go ba/ yon tan thob ba'i tshul lo// drug pa 'gro ba'i yid bzhin du 'jug pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la drug /yab kyi yon tan/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ byed pa'i yon tan/ glu bstan pa/ don bshad pa/ don du gyur pa'o// bdun pa 'dod pa'i nyes pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la don gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la drug /nga la nu ji ltar byung ba/ rgyal srid thob pa'i tshul/ gnas kyi khyad par/ drang srong la bsgo ba/

des gling bzhi la dbang byas pa/ mi rtag pa bstan pa'o// lnga pa la brgyad/ 'dzam bu'i gling du gnas tshul/ lus 'phags su gnas pa/ nub dang byang du gnas pa/ lha yul du chas pa/ ri bdun la gnas pa/ smon lam gyi mthu bstan pa/ lha rnams kyis ma bkag pa/ sum bcu rtsa gsum du phyin pa'o// de la bzhi/ ji ltar mthong ba/ gror khyer bshad pa/ gral la 'dug pa/ lha las 'phags pa bstan pa'o// drug pa la bzhi/ mi rtag pa'i rkyen/ dris lan gyis mi rtag pa bstan pa/ mchod sbyin byas pa/ mi rtag pa brjod pa'o// brgyad pa 'byor pas sems can bkri bar bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan/ des gzhan don mdzad tshul lo// de la drug ste/ sems can gyi spyod pa gzigs pa/ don mdzad pa dngos/ de bshad pa/ dus ci tsam mdzad pa/ thabs mkhas pa'i don/ don gzhan bstan pa'o// dgu pa zhi bas 'dul ba bstan pa la don gsum ste 'tsham sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan/ gnas kyi khyad par/ des don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la lnga ste/ spre'u ji ltar gnas pa/ gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i phyir dris lan/ snying rje'i spyod pa bstan pa/ ji ltar btang ba/ don du gyur pa'i tshul lo// bcu pa de bzhin gshegs pas lung bstan pa thob pa'i skyes rabs la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ spyi dang bye brag gi yon tan dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i tshul dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan mdor bstan/ spyi'i yon tan no// sprin gyi yon tan no// gnyis pa la bzhi/ grong khyer du phyin pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par mthong ba/ mchod sbyin gyi gnas su 'dug pa/ rnyed pa 'thob pa'o// gsum pa la bcu gnyis/

rgyal po'i pho brang du phyin pa/ mchod pa'i yo byad btsal ba/ bzang legs ldan dang dris lan/ ut+pal 'dod pa'i dris lan/ yid dang mthun par byas pa/ mchod pa'i bkod pa/ sangs rgyas mthong ba/ smon lam btab pa/ cho 'phrul mthong ba/ lung bstan pa/ dga' ba thob pa/ sangs rgyas mnyes par byas pa'o// brgyad pa smon lam gyi bcu tshan la bcu ste/ smon lam thog ma nyid du gal che bar bstan pa dang*/ smon lam gyis dge ba bstan pa dang*/ smon lam gyis bsod nams thob pa dang*/ smon lam gyis don byed pa dang*/ smon lam gyis gzhan 'dun par byed pa dang*/ don bya ba la 'jug pa dang*/ smon lam gyis 'gro ba skyob pa dang*/ skyo ba med pa'i smon lam dang*/ smon lam dang ldan par thams cad gtong ba dang*/ smon lam gyi stobs bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la brgyad ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ glang po btul ba/ nyams sad pa/ glang po ches khyer zhing dris lan byas pa/ dul ma dul brtags pa/ rgyu dris lan/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bstan pa/ mchod sbyin mdzad de smon lam btab pa'o// gnyis pa smon lam gyi dge ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ sangs rgyas byon pa/ mchod cing smon lam btab pa'i tshul lo// de la bzhi/ mchod pa'i bkod pa/ cho 'phrul mthong ba/ bstod cing smon lam btab pa/ de'i 'bras bu'o// gsum pa smon lam gyi bsod nams thob pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ chos bstan pa gnas pa/ smon lam btab pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// de la drug /smon lam 'debs pa'i rkyen/ chos thos shing bsams pa/ des bskul ma thob pa/ mchod cing smon lam btab pa/

khyim du phyin pa/ 'bras bu thob pa'i tshul lo de la bzhi/ 'bras bu cung mthong ba/ de grags pa'i tshul/ bsod nams spel ba/ 'bras bu rgyas bshad do// de la gsum/ rgyal por gyur pa/ bsod nams bsags pa/ phyi ma'i 'bras bu'o// bzhi pa smon lam gyi don byed pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gzhan don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la gnyis spyir bskyangs pa dang*/ bye brag tu nad gsos pa'o// de la brgyad/ nad kyi bskal pa nye bar gnas pa/ ji ltar zin tshul/ sprul zhing sgra bsgrags pa/ smon lam bstan pa/ nad zhi ba/ gzhan dag ni gsol pa/ rjes su bstan pa/ bsgrub pa'i tshul lo// lnga pa smon lam gyis gzhan 'dun pa byed pa bstan pa'i skyes rab la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gnas kyi khyad par/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan des gnod byed 'dun par mdzad pa'am/ de la drug /gnod par byed pa'i rkyen/ gnod byed nye bar gnas pa/ ba glang mo dang dris lan byas ba/ nyes pa'i rgyu dris lan/ dris lan gyis bzod pa bstan pa/ ji ltar 'dun par gyur pa'o// de la lnga/ skyabs mdzad pa/ 'dun te dris lan byas pa/ byang chub sems pas ji 'dod dris pa/ mche ba bslang pa/ mche ba byin pa'i tshul lo de la bzhi/ de nas sems bskyed pa/ lha rnams kyi smras byang chub sems pas smras pa/ byin cing smon lam btab pa'o// drug pa don bya ba la 'jug pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems pa'i yon tan/ de ji ltar bsam gtan thob pa/ gzhan don mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ bsam gtan bsgrub pa'i rkyen/ gnas dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ mngon shes thob pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mthong ba/

'gro ba gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mthong ba/ de dag gi don byas pa'o// bdun pa smon lam gyi 'gro ba skyob pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ gzhan la phan pa mdzad tshul lo// de la lnga ste/ bstan pa la zhugs par bskul ba/ zhugs pa'i tshul/ bu drug dang dris lan/ rgyal srid byin te rab tu byung ba/ gtong ba chen po mdzad pa'o// de la bdun/ gtong ba'i rkyen/ thugs la dgongs pa/ lus btang zhing smon lam btab pa/ ltas kyi khyad par/ ji ltar btang ba/ bstod pa/ don bshad pa'o// brgyad pa skye ba med pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum te/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la brgyad de byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ mchod sbyin bsgrubs pa/ nyan thos mi 'jug pa'i rgyu bsam pa/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du phyin pa/ dad pa/ zhu ba byas pa/ de'i tshul bshad pa/ mchod cing smon lam btab pa'o// de la bdun/ 'khor la bsgo ba/ mi ma yin rnams bskul ba/ grogs byas pa/ sangs rgyas byon pa/ smon lam btab pa/ sems can rnams lung bstan pa/ yid rang ba'o// dgu pa smon lam dang ldan par thams cad gtong ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ sbyin gtong gi khyad par/ smon lam btab pa/ rgyu des sems can rnams kyis bslangs shing byin pa'i tshul lo// de la bcu ste/ sras byin pa/ btsun mo byin pa/ rgyal srid byin pa/ rkang pa byin pa/ mig byin pa/ snyan byin pa/ lag pa byin pa/ don brjod pa/ smon lam chen po bskyed pa'o// de la gsum/ mi rnams kyis spangs pa/ smon lam mdzad pa/ de'i don brjod pa'o// bcu pa smon lam gyi stobs bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/

'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la drug te byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan mdor bstan/ skye bo bskyangs pa'i tshul/ de'i 'bras bu mthong ba/ lha rnams kyis bsgrags pa/ brgya byin gyis bstod pa/ des rmad du byung ba'i spyod pa mdzad pa'o// de la lnga/ lha rnams the tshom gyis dris lan byas pa/ btsun mo dang blon po nas rmi lam mthong ba/ sdug bsngal ba rnams dbugs phyung ba dang*/ btsun mo byin pa dang*/ lus byin pa'i tshul lo// bzhi pa la lnga ste/ slong ba'i rkyen/ ji ltar slong du phyin pa/ bslangs pa dngos/ byin pa'i tshul/ ltas kyi khyad par ro// lnga pa la lnga ste/ brgya byin gyis bltas pa/ sprul pa byas pa/ gzhan dag dang dris lan/ ltas kyi khyad par/ sbyin pa mdzad pa dngos so// de la bcu bdun/ dris pa dang*/ lus bslangs pa/ blon po dang dris lan byas pa/ sbyin par smras pa/ shing mkhan bos pa/ blon po chen po dang dris lan/ shing mkhan dang dris lan/ smon lam byas pa/ gzhan dag mya ngan skyes pa/ dbugs phyung ba/ blon pos bzlog pa/ byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ blon po nas smra sngags brjod pa/ lus bcad pa'i tshul/ gzhan la phan par mthong ba/ ltas kyi khyad par/ lus sor chud pa'o// de la lnga/ brgya byin gyi rkyen byas pa/ bden tshigs brjod pa/ dga' ba'i khyad par bsgrags pa/ brgya byin gyis gsol ba/ btsun mo yang slar phul pa'o// dgu pa stobs kyi bcu mtshan la bcu ste/ snying rje'i stobs dang*/ sbyin pa'i stobs dang*/ phan par byed pa'i stobs dang*/ tshul khrims kyi stobs dang*/ bzod pa'i stobs dang*/ dud 'gror gyur kyang brtson pa mi 'dor pa'i stobs dang*/ brtson grus kyi stobs dang*/ 'jig rten gyi brtson pa'i stobs dang*/ srid zhu byed pa'i stobs dang*/ bsod nams kyi stobs so// dang po la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga ste/

rgyal po'i yon tan/ sras kyi yon tan/ skyed mos tshal du phyin pa/ gzhon nu rnams dris lan byas pa/ byang chub sems dpas sbyin pa byas pa'o// de la brgyad ste/ snying rje'i yul mthong ba/ dris lan byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dgongs pa/ lus ji ltar btang ba/ ltas kyi khyad par/ phu bo gnyis dogs pa skyes pa/ mya ngan byas pa/ rgyal po yab yum gyis mya ngan byas pa'o// de la lnga/ ltas mthong ba/ ji ltar thos pa/ smre sngags brjod pa/ mchod pa/ gang yin bstan pa'o// gnyis pa sbyin pa'i stobs bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gnas dang bdag po'i yon tan/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul/ sbyin pa mdzad pa'o// de la bcu ste/ ltas mthong ba/ dbugs phyung ba/ slong ba chas pa/ ltas drang srong gis smras pa/ lha mos sbran pa/ gegs byas pa/ blon pos thabs byas pa/ mya ngan skyes pa/ bram zes dbu bslangs pa/ de'i lan/ ji ltar byin pa'o// de la dgu ste/ skye bo rnams 'dus pa/ rgyu des dris lan/ rjes su bstan pa/ yang dris lan byas pa/ lha mos bzlog pa/ de la gdams pa/ ji ltar btang ba/ mthu'i khyad par bstan pa/ gang yin bstan pa'o// gsum pa phan par byed pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gzhan phan mdzad pa'o// de la bcu/ snying rje'i yul lhags pa/ rgyal pos mthong ba/ sman pa la dris pa/ bdag nyid la brtags pa/ sbyin pa byas pa/ gzhan dag mya ngan skyes pa/ rang gi yon tan/ de'i rgyas bshad/ drin du mi bzo ba'i nyes pa bstan pa/ phyis byung ba'o// bzhi pa tshul khrims kyi stobs bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ 'byor pa'i khyad par/

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'o// de la lnga/ thugs la dgongs pa dang*/ de'i tshul brjod pa/ bram ze rnams dang dris lan/ rab tu byung ba/ chos bstan pa'o// de la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug sdud do// lnga pa bzod pa'i stobs bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ ming don bshad pa/ des bzod pa'i khyad par bstan pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ ma rangs pa spyod pa'i tshul/ de la dgongs pa/ skyo ba med pa/ slar sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o// de la bzhi ste/ chos thos pa/ yon tan bstan pa/ byang chub la bkod pa/ de la bsngags pa'o// drug pa dud 'gror gyur kyang brtson pa mi 'dor ba bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ gnas dang bdag po'i yon tan/ des snying rje'i spyod pa bstan pa'o// de la dgu snying rje'i yul gnas pa/ tshong pa la 'jigs pa bskyed pa/ mya ngan byas pa/ byang chub sems pa'i snying rje skyes pa/ glang po dang dris lan/ sbrul bsad pa/ tshong pa ngo mtshar ba/ lhas bstan pa/ mchod cing bstod pa'o// bdun pa brtson 'grus kyi stobs bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ brtson 'grus bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ spyod tshul lo// gnyis pa la drug te/ nor bu bsgrub pa'i rkyen/ thugs la dgongs pa/ pha ma la gsol pa/ nor bu'i gling du phyin pa/ nor bu rgya mtshor lhung pa/ brtson 'grus kyis blangs pa'o// de la bdun/ brtson pa bstan pa/ rgya mtsho dang dris lan/ nor bu thob pa/ de rigs pa'i tshul/ gzhan don grub pa/ bstod pa'o// brgyad pa 'jig rten pa dang mthun pa'i stobs bstan pa la gsum ste/

'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ phas longs spyod byin pa/ ji ltar longs spyod thob pa/ mchod sbyin byas pa'o// gsum pa la lnga ste/ yid 'phrog thob pa'i rkyen/ rngon pas bzung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' la phul ba/ ji ltar dgyes pa/ 'jig rten las 'phags pa'i brtson 'grus bstan pa'o// de la gsum/ bram zes rkyen byas pa/ ri bor ma btul ba/ mi'am ci'i grong khyer du phyin pa'o// gnyis pa la brgyad/ nor bzang btang ba/ gnod sbyin gyis btul ba/ rgyal pos rmi lam mthong ba/ bram zes log par bstan pa/ de ltar byas pa/ yid 'phrog bros pa/ drang srong la smras pa/ gzhon nu pho brang du phyin pa'o// mi'am ci'i grong du phyin pa la dgu te dris lan smras pa/ bsrungs pa/ rim pas tshig bcad smras pa/ drang srong dang dris lan/ mi'am ci'i gnas su phyin pa/ ljon pa dang yid 'phrog dris lan/ stobs bstan pa/ yid 'phrog phul ba/ yul du phyin pa'o// bzhi pa mchod sbyin byas pa la gnyis/ rgyal por gyur pa/ mchod sbyin mdzad pa'o// dgu pa sri zhu'i stobs bstan pa la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ gleng gzhi dang*/ gnod byed nye bar gnas pa/ rgyu des sri zhu bstan pa'o// de la dgu/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ lhas sbran pa/ bsams pa/ btsun mo dang dris lan/ yul pha rol du phyin pa/ nyams thag pa/ rgyu des dris lan/ rgyal bus gsol te dong ba/ don grub pa'i tshul lo// de la bcu gcig yab yum mya ngan skyes pa/ rgyal bus gsol pa/ smon lam byas pa/ ltas kyi khyad par/ rgyu des brgya byin gyi brtags pa/ dris lan/ smon lam gyis lus sngar bzhin grub pa/ brgya byin ngo mtshar te bstod pa/ pha ma dang phrad pa/ don grub pa/ gang yin bstan pa'o// bcu pa bsod nams kyi stobs bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum te/

'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ bsod nam kyi stobs bstan pa'o// dang po la bzhi ste/ bltams pa'i snga ltas btsun mos chos bstan pa/ yon tan dngos/ yi dwags kyi don mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa la bdun/ phu bo rnams kyis glengs ba dang*/ bsod nams kyi yon tan bshad pa dang*/ de'i don btags pa/ bsod nams stobs kyi yon tan/ grags pa rgyas pa/ snying rje'i spyod pa dang*/ rgyal po mdzad pa'i tshul lo// drug pa la drug snying rje'i yul dbugs phyung ba/ yan lag byin pa/ phan thogs shing smon lam btab pa/ ltas kyi khyad par/ rgyu des brgya byin gyis brtags pa/ smon lam gyis lus sngar bzhin gyur pa'o// gnyis pa/ rgyal po mdzad pa la bdun te/ rkyen nye bar gnas pa/ ltas mthong ba/ rgyal por gyur pa/ phu bo rnams 'dus pa/ ji ltar phan pa byas pa/ yab kyis dbang bskur ba/ yon tan no// bcu pa ye shes kyi bcu tshan la bcu ste/ ye shes kyi rgyu bstan pa dang*/ ji lta bar mkhyen pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'dzin pa dang*/ grangs thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i ye shes dang*/ snying rje chen po'i ye shes dang*/ 'jig rten ston pa'i ye shes dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes dang*/ brtson 'grus la smad pa'i ye shes dang*/ bdud kyi stobs 'joms pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang rjes su mthun par bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des ye shes btsal ba'o// de la drug ste/ rang gis brtags pa dang*/ btsal ba dang*/ drang srong kun rig gzigs pa dang*/ de dang dris lan/ des bshad pa/ gang yin bshad pa'o// gnyis pa ji lta mkhyen pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/

byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ dben pa mdzad pa/ 'khrul tshul gzigs pa/ ji ltar mngon du rtogs pa'o// de la gnyis/ bdag lta spang ba dang*/ don mthong ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// de la bzhi ste/ phung po lnga bdag tu mi rung ba'i tshul/ de la rtag cing med pa/ de las gzhan du yang mi rigs pa/ bdag de gzugs can la gzugs med du mi rigs par bstan pas so// de la lnga ste/ bdag gzugs kyi rjes su 'gro ldog mi 'thad pa dang*/ dngos med du mi 'thad pa dang*/ gzhan gyi rjes su 'gro na rang dbang can du mi 'thad pa dang*/ bde sdug gi rgyur mi rung ba/ ngo bos grub na 'bad pa don med pa'o// gnyis pa don mthong ba la gnyis/ rten 'brel mthong ba/ gzhan don mdzad pa'o// gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'dzin pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bdun/ sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ chos bsgros pa/ lha rnams mi mthun par gyur pa/ tog gi blo gros kyis smras pa/ de'i lan/ mi yul du dong ba/ de ltar chos bsgros pa'o// de la brgyad ste/ lha rnams kyis mchod/ dge ba'i blo gros bsam pa/ rgyu des snying rje skyes pa/ des smras pa/ bdag yod med kyi dris lan/ don mthong zhing ched du brjod pa/ de'i yon tan/ don bshad pa'o// bzhi pa grangs thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i ye shes bstan pa la lnga ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang*/ drang srong snang ba yis mkhyen pa dang*/ sngo bsangs kyis mkhyen pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ n+yas gro ta gnas pa dang*/ drang srong gis mngon shes thob tshul/ 'dab ma bsgrangs pa'o// gsum pa la drug ji ltar phrad pa/ dris lan/ grangs bshad pa/ ngo mtshar skyes te dris pa/ de'i lan/ sngo bsangs la bstod pa'o// lnga pa snying rje chen po'i ye shes la don gsum ste/

'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan no// des gzhan don ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la gnyis te/ lta ngan bsal ba dang*/ gso ba bstan pa'o// dang po la drug ste/ snying rje skyes pa/ chos ston pa'i rgyu/ bdag med par bstan pa/ dbugs phyung ba dang*/ brngub pa bstan pa/ de'i yon tan no// gso ba bstan pa la gsum te nad kyi nyes pa byung ba/ de'i gnyen po mdzad pa'o// phan yon brjod pa'o// drug pa 'jig rten ston pa'i ye shes la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' ji ltar 'khrungs pa/ dben pa bsten pa/ rgyu des thams cad 'dus shing dris lan byas pa/ rgyu skar bstan pa'o// de la gnyis te/ dris ba dang*/ lan no// de la bcu ste/ smin drug bstan pa/ rgyu skar gzhan rgyas bshad/ bya ba dang dus rnams bstan pa/ dri ba byas pa/ gzhan dag yid rang ba/ bstan pa'i rgyu bstan/ chos bstan pa/ slar brgya byin dang dris lan/ 'jig rten thams cad la gdams pa/ don brjod pa'o// bdun pa thabs mkhas pa'i ye shes la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba dang*/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des don gyi gnas lugs /gzigs pa/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa'o// de la lnga ste/ sdug bsngal ba gzigs pa/ zang zing sbyin pa/ chos bstan pa/ rgyu des lha rnams dris lan/ sum bcu rtsa gsum du phyin pa'o// de la bdun te ma ti li dang dris lan/ lam du sems can gyi don byas pa/ lha rnams kyis bsu ba/ brgya byin gyis bsngags pa/ slar dris lan/ 'dzam bu'i gling du phyin pa/ don bshad pa'o// brgyad pa brtson grus ma smad pa bstan pa la gsum ste// 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu pa'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/

sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ rgyal po'i yon tan/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa/ log lta btul ba'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ sangs rgyas mchod pa/ chos bstan pa'i yon tan no// bzhi pa la drug ste/ log lta ji ltar byung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' snying rje skyes pa/ brtson pa la zhugs pa/ phal cher btul ba/ de'i tshul brjod pa/ shor ba gzhon nu btul ba'o// de la gsum ste/ smon lam log par btab pa/ de btul ba/ dul ba'i tshul lo// dgu pa bdud kyi sde 'joms pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ bdud kyi bar chod byed tshul/ de btul ba'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ bdud kyi bsam pa dang*/ bar chod byas tshul lo// bzhi pa la brgyad de/ sprul pa byas pa/ bdud mya ngan skyes pa/ lha'i bu mo rnams kyis smras pa/ mi rtag pa skyes pa/ gsol ba btab pa lan smras pa/ chos bstan pa/ dul ba'i tshul lo// bcu pa sangs rgyas dang rjes su mthun pa bstan pa'i skyes rabs la gsum ste/ 'tshams sbyar ba/ rtogs pa brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ sngon gyi gleng gzhi/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan/ des gzhan don mdzad pa'i tshul lo// de la gsum ste/ rdzu 'phrul bstan pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang dris lan no// de la bdun te/ 'od bkye ba/ rjes su song ba/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus song ba/ bstod pa brjod pa/ rjes su bstan pa thos pa/ zhing khams thams cad du bsgrags pa/ don brjod pa'o// mthar phyin pa'i mdzad pa la bcu gnyis te/ dga' ldan nas 'pho ba dang*/ lhums su 'jug pa dang*/ bltams pa dang*/ bzo dang*/ rol brtsed/ mngon par byung ba dang*/ dka' ba spyad pa dang*/ byang chub kyi shing drung du gshegs pa dang*/ bdud btul ba dang*/ byang chub pa dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'o// dang po la drug ste/

lam yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul/ rgyal tshab du gyur pa/ khyad par gyi yon tan/ thugs la dgongs pa/ sangs rgyas kyis bskul ba/ gzigs par mdzad pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lhums su 'jug tshul bstan pa/ rmi lam dris lan/ lhums su zhugs pa'i tshul lo// gsum pa la dgu ste/ dus shes pa/ btsun mo'i bsams pa/ bkod pa'i khyad par/ shing rta'i bkod pa/ lu bhi ni'i tshal du song ba'i tshul/ bltams pa'i tshul/ ched du brjod pa/ ltas dang bstod pa'i khyad par/ don bsdu ba'o// bzhi pa la bzhi ste/ slob pa'i tshul/ zhing pa'i grong du byon pa/ drang srong gis bstod pa/ rgyal pos bstod pa'o// lnga pa la lnga ste/ rol rtsed ston pa'i rgyu/ dris lan/ shākya be con dang dris lan/ rol rtsed bstan pa dngos/ btsun mo phul ba'o// drug pa la bcu gnyis te/ mngon par 'byung bar dgongs pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs pa/ dge sbyong gzigs pa/ don brjod pa/ ji ltar bsrungs ba'i tshul/ rab tu byung ba'i don du yab dang dris lan/ lha rnams kyi bskul ba/ mdun pa dang dris lan/ ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ dam bcas pa/ rab tu byung ba/ rgyal po dang mdun pa dris lan no// bdun pa la lnga ste/ ji ltar byon pa/ gzugs can snying po dang dris lan/ dka' spyad mdzad pa/ de'i tshul brjod pa/ don bsdu ba'o// brgyad pa la lnga ste/ mtha' gnyis spang ba'i tshul/ shing drung du gshegs pa/ klu dung can gyis bstod pa/ shing drung du bzhugs pa'i tshul/ mchod pa dang bkod pa'i khyad par ro// dgu pa la bcu ste/ bdud bskul ba/ bdud kyi dmag bsdus pa/ de'i tshul/ ji ltar snang ba/ bdud dang dris lan/ bdud byer ba/ bdud kyi bu mo dang dris lan/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du 'ongs pa/ btul ba'i tshul/ don bsdu ba'o// bcu pa la gsum ste/ byang chub pa'i tshul/ ched du brjod pa/ bkod pa'i khyad par ro/ bcu gcig pa la lnga ste/ bdun phrag bdun gyi mdzad pa/

lhung bzed dang bsod snyoms phul ba/ shin tu zab pa'i dgongs pa/ tshangs pas bskul ba/ 'khor lo bskor ba dngos so// de la lnga ste/ dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ zhar la sngags bstan pa'i tshul/ de'i don bsdu ba'o// bcu gnyis pa la bcu ste/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gsung bsgrags pa/ 'khor bsdus pa 'dus pa/ gdul bya'i tha ma btul ba/ kun dga' bos khri bshams shing smre sngags brjod pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa/ de'i tshul rgyas bshad/ sku gdung byon pa'i tshul/ gang gis mchod pa/ ji ltar spel ba/ don bsdu ba'o// gsum pa rjes kyi don la brgyad de/ sde snod kyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul/ slob dpon dpa' bos ji ltar bsdus tshul/ phyi ma ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul/ de rigs par bstan pa/ blang dor brtag pa/ rgyu mtshan gang gis byas pa/ bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa/ yongs su rdzogs par bstan pa'o/// /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa gsal byed pa'i/ mdor bsdus rig pa bstan pa 'di/ gzhan gyi don du 'gyur snyam nas/ rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba yin/ dge bas sems can ma lus pa/ rgyal sras spyod la 'jug par shog //dge'o/// /bkra shis so/// /
